why: I re-ran my M1 mutant in a fresh clone at 92e25ce. defence fails with 4 DI failures; on the clean branch it passes, with 8 clauses checked. Omnissiah’s Blessing (a|xebbb5, "regains up to D3 lost wounds and, if it is a VEHICLE model, … Feel No Pain 5+") gives no false failure: its itIs condition and its fnp are both in the clause. My own DI mutations, each run on clean data and on M1 data. (a) IF_CUT regex made never to match: M1 is still caught by the fixed case’s signature. With the fixed case also removed, M1 passes, so the regex carries the clause check. (b) findDf over the whole quote in place of the clause: the same, caught by the fixed case alone, and M1 passes without it. (c) The before/after-cut test inverted (pr(id, parts[0])): the same. (d) The fixed case removed: still caught by the clause check (2 failures). (e) The "&& !pr(id, parts[0])" guard dropped: M1 is still caught (4 failures), and clean data still passes (0 failures). This guard only stops false failures; no sentence in today’s data has the condition before the cut too, so no case exercises it, and dropping it makes DI stricter, not weaker. No mutation raises a false failure on clean data. Cold gate at 92e25ce, in a fresh clone with nothing in verify/out: 27 steps pass; only snapshots (basic-bitch, shooty, byte-identical to scratchpad/bb-work) and helpers (1 item, the ability tag) fail.
